title: Microsoft Teams: Channel Agent works with GitHub, Asana and Jira through MCP servers
summary: The briefing passes: it accurately distinguishes the paused preview rollout from the roadmap's older Rolling out status. The licensing, Channel Agent controls and EDU default are supported, and the remaining MCP-specific questions are appropriately reported as documentation gaps.
